partners.name: The Coffee
partners.why_now: Reported on 2026-09-29 to be expanding in Portugal with three more units in Lisbon. That’s a strong near-term footprint expansion signal and shows the brand is actively scaling in the city now. Source: dnbrasil.dn.pt coverage of the Lisbon expansion.

partners.name: Delta Cafés / Delta Coffee House Experience
partners.why_now: In 2026, Delta continued to roll out its Coffee House Experience format in Lisbon, including a new opening in Cais do Sodré and a separate Coffee Club activation in central Lisbon in late October 2026. Multiple city-center moves in the same year indicate strong momentum and test-and-scale behavior. Sources: Forbes Portugal and Grande Consumo coverage.

partners.name: The Standard, Lisbon
partners.why_now: Hyatt’s Standard brand was slated to open in Lisbon in 2026 at Palácio Santa Clara, adding a high-profile lifestyle/boutique hotel to the market. This is a strong growth signal because it reflects continued premium brand investment in Lisbon and new guest-volume potential for wholesale amenities. Sources: Hotel News Resource and Hyatt/Standard-related coverage.
